Quaternius Universal Animation Library — Standard (v3.0)

Creator: Quaternius
Official source: https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library
Creator website: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html
Free Standard download: Universal Animation Library[Standard].zip
Itch upload ID: 17958403 (June 2026 release)
Original file: Unreal-Godot/UAL1_Standard.glb
Downloaded: 2026-10-11

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0), Public Domain Dedication
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Included files:
- quaternius-source.glb: source humanoid rig, inverse bind matrices, and 24
  selected source animation clips. Render meshes, materials, and unrelated
  clips removed. Repeated constant keyframes compacted without removing
  transforms needed for retargeting.
- quaternius-fighter-animations.glb: the same 24 clips baked offline onto
  Emberfall's existing Adventurer/Punk/King fighter skeleton at 30 fps.
- quaternius-actor-knight-animations.glb and
  quaternius-avatar-{adventurer,astronaut,mask,pirate,robot,skeleton,tribal,wizard}-animations.glb:
  separate 30 fps bakes for each character's individual 19-bone bind pose.
  A-pose arm references are aligned before motion transfer. Each character's
  bone lengths and skin bind matrices are preserved.
- quaternius-animation-info.json: provenance, original keyframe counts,
  character-to-animation-asset mapping, bone mapping, clip durations, and
  numerical retarget checks. Each of the other rigs has a matching info file.

Selected clips: Idle_Loop, Walk_Loop, Jog_Fwd_Loop, Sprint_Loop, Jump_Start,
Jump_Loop, Jump_Land, Sword_Idle, Sword_Attack, Hit_Chest, Crouch_Fwd_Loop,
Crouch_Idle_Loop, Dance_Loop, Death01, Hit_Head, Idle_Talking_Loop, Interact,
PickUp_Table, Roll, Spell_Simple_Enter, Spell_Simple_Exit,
Spell_Simple_Idle_Loop, Spell_Simple_Shoot, Walk_Formal_Loop.

The expanded selection uses the same official free Standard archive. It
adds crouch, formal walking, talking, interacting, picking up a table-height
object, dancing, rolling, head-hit reaction, death, and four spell phases.
Standard contains only one Sword_Attack; the selection does not include
or imply paid-pack sword variants, directional strafing, or bow animations.

The original source file has root motion disabled. Retargeting transfers
world rotations through both rigs' inverse bind matrices, preserves target
limb lengths, reconstructs local transforms, and bakes explicit positions
for the target's root-parented Foot.L and Foot.R deform bones. A small body
height adjustment preserves the source support-foot height across the
different leg proportions. No generated or replacement motion is used.

Rebuild every character with: node scripts/import-quaternius.mjs --all

The new retargeting implementation is provided under CC0. The original
character rig/model licenses continue to apply; see CREDITS.txt and
V3-CREDITS.txt. In particular, the Knight rig is adapted from Knight by
Dawid2K, under CC BY 3.0:
https://poly.pizza/m/isC73B8SKq
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Changes: source rotations retargeted onto the adapted Knight skeleton;
animated local transforms baked at 30 fps. No Knight geometry or textures
are duplicated in the animation-only GLB. The creator does not endorse
this adaptation or Emberfall.

The creator's OpenGameArt posting provides an older Standard release:
https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library
It was inspected for license verification; the included motion comes from
the newer official June 2026 itch.io release above.
